after.long: Preview or confirm one bounded Codex start. --check is the default and writes nothing. --apply requires --confirm with the exact preview digest. Request schema 1 (interactive) requires text output and a foreground macOS terminal; its child inherits the terminal. In interactive mode, without a human task observation, exit 5 with task_run_task_status_unknown means collection is waiting for that observation. Factory exec request schema 2 uses pipes and permits --format json without a terminal; stdout is one Ply result and provider streams stay in bound private files. Result collection runs after the child exits; exec uses runner-owned completion evidence. A reserved run or factory slot is never relaunched. Exec requires a hash-bound factory authorization and narrow managed policy; one native terminal turn, reaped exit zero and empty owned process group establish inactivity. Unknown completion exits 5 and preserves the environment.
